message: You know those family group chats that light up like a Christmas tree during a storm? Well, I find myself toggling between sharing weather updates and making sure everyone knows where the flashlight is. It’s a bit of a juggling act! I came across a handy guide from the National Weather Service about staying safe during floods. It’s like having a little calm amidst the storm—just a good reminder to keep our wits about us. Have you checked your emergency supplies lately? 🌧️
